initial_scene: Humanoid standing beside a white table, facing the black plastic bag with a broad red opening/inner panel. The bag lies broad and puffed on the table. Both hands initially hang below the tabletop.

observed_sequence.action: Robot stands still beside the bag with hands lowered; bag remains untouched.
Left arm bends and raises its open hand forward over the near side of the table; right hand becomes visible beyond it and rises toward the far side. Body stays in place.
Both hands lower to opposite sides of the bag. Left open hand arrives at the red/black near edge while right hand reaches the far black edge.

Right hand closes against the far side and draws black material inward; left hand holds the near red/black side as the edges gather toward one another. Bag surface rises and creases between the hands.
observed_sequence.confidence: high for movement and deformation; medium for exact pinch locations

observed_sequence.action: Both hands maintain the gathered sides, holding a central crumpled mound on the table with small coordinated adjustments. The rest of the bag stays supported by the tabletop.
Hands separate and open, releasing the gathered material. Bag loosens and spreads back onto the tabletop as hands lift clear.
Both open hands withdraw toward the body; the bag settles in a broad, loosely wrinkled shape on the table.
Robot holds hands clear near the waist/table edge; the bag remains stationary, with red panel visible and black upper surface still raised.

arm_hand_roles.left: Near-camera arm, continuously traceable from the visible left shoulder. Raises first, lowers to the near red/black edge, holds/gathers that side while the opposite hand draws the far side inward, then opens and withdraws.
arm_hand_roles.right: Far-camera arm, partly occluded by the torso/left arm initially. Reaches to the far black side, closes on/gathers material toward the middle and coordinates with the left hand before opening and withdrawing.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Hands approach separate sides, gather the flexible bag between them without a hand-to-hand transfer or full lift, and release together while the tabletop supports the bag. No person interacts and no locomotion occurs.

anatomical_side_evidence.convention: Robot-relative anatomical sides, independent of image left/right.
anatomical_side_evidence.evidence: In the source initial PNG and native frames, cyan front face profile and front torso point toward image left; rear backpack/straps are behind the torso toward image right. Camera views the robot from its left side: prominent near shoulder and its continuous upper-arm/elbow/wrist chain are the left arm. The opposite arm appears beyond the front torso and is the right arm. Native 100/144/158 and later withdrawal frames expose both attachments and preserve the same mapping.

terminal_state: Both hands are open and clear of the bag. Black/red bag remains on the tabletop, loosely crumpled and still visibly raised/puffy rather than tightly compressed or folded; no sealed closure or carried placement occurs.
uncertainties: The exact film pinch points are partly hidden by opaque hand housings and bag folds, although coordinated contact, inward gathering and release are visible.
Air displacement and lasting reduction in bag volume cannot be confirmed visually; the bag spreads again after release and retains a raised profile.
annotation_discrepancies: Original instruction describes reducing volume and air displacement. Visible evidence supports gathering/bunching and release, but does not establish lasting volume reduction or measurable air displacement.
execution_status_rationale: The gathering and release are complete, but success of the source objective of reducing bag volume is not visually established.
